I had a very disappointing experience at Petco today. I brought my dogs, Zulema and Napoleón, in for grooming services, and everything turned into a frustrating situation.

I had both of their vaccination records with me, yet they kept making excuses and even made me call the veterinarian who administered the vaccines to verify the information. Despite providing everything they asked for, they still refused to bathe Zulema, claiming she was biting the staff — which is very surprising, since she has always been groomed at other places without any issues. Honestly, it felt like they just didn’t want to do their job.

As for Napoleón, I was originally told it would be $70 for a full grooming service (bath, haircut, etc.), so it doesn’t make sense that the haircut would only be $10 when they ended up charging me $60 just for the bath. On top of that, they didn’t cut his hair as requested, returned him with a lot of knots still in his fur, and told me he had been very aggressive — which again is not consistent with his behavior at other grooming locations.

Overall, the experience felt unprofessional, poorly handled, and overpriced for the quality of service provided. I expected much better care, transparency, and professionalism.

Review Title: Dangerous Defective Product, Overcharged, Zero Accountability, Avoid at All Costs

I am extremely disappointed with Petco and will never purchase from them again.

I purchased what was advertised as an insulated outdoor cat house for an outdoor cat. Not only was I overcharged by $45, but the product I received was completely defective and unsafe. The structure had sharp, jagged edges, and I severely injured my hands while handling it. This is a serious safety hazard for both animals and people.

My cat will not go inside it at all, which tells me everything I need to know about how unsafe and poorly constructed it is. An insulated outdoor shelter should provide protection and security, not danger.

I immediately contacted Petco and provided all required documentation, including purchase date, delivery date, and clear proof of the defect. I also contacted corporate three separate times. Each time I was told someone would call me back. No one ever did.

Instead of taking responsibility, Petco told me to contact the manufacturer. That is unacceptable. I did not purchase this item from the manufacturer. Petco took my money, Petco sold the product, and Petco delivered it. Responsibility does not get passed off when a product is defective and dangerous.

Petco claims to care about animal welfare, yet they sell unsafe products, overcharge customers, and then ignore serious safety complaints. This demonstrates a complete disregard for animals and for the people who care for them.

I am posting this publicly so other customers are warned. If you value your pets and your safety, do not buy from Petco.

If you want a company with outstanding customer service and accountability, buy from Chewy instead. The difference is night and day

I took my mini Goldendoodle here for grooming because I do my best to keep him well cared for. I brush him daily—his coat is curly and can get tangled despite my efforts, but I’m consistent.

The first time I took him in, he came back with a cut on his genital area and another one higher up on his belly. While the haircut itself was acceptable and we had agreed not to shave him down completely, the injury was very concerning and made me reluctant to return.

Unfortunately, due to scheduling conflicts at other grooming locations, I had no choice but to bring him back for a second visit. I explained the previous issue to the groomer and asked them to please be careful and not shave him too short. The groomer insisted it was impossible not to shave him completely, including removing all hair from his ears, which I found excessive.

My dog was returned to me completely shaved, with visible irritation on two paws, and a small cut on the tip of his ear. What’s worse, he had hair left inside his ear canal, which required a trip to the vet and could have led to a serious ear infection (otitis) if left untreated.

I left the store with a dog who was visibly uncomfortable, physically injured, and clearly not handled with the care and gentleness every pet deserves.

This was a deeply upsetting experience. I trusted Petco with my dog’s wellbeing, and I regret it. I hope this review helps other pet owners make informed decisions. I will not be returning.
